_what: Run log A2 — the N≥10 re-baseline that E0's contingency 2 demands. Same gate, same slots, same fixture as E0-shape-revalidation; only n_per_arm changes (3 → 10). Run on template v0.4, not v1: plan §8.7 schedules the re-baseline at step 4e after the v1 freeze, but E0's contingency fired now and blocks both work lines (run log A6). This will be redone at the v1 freeze — that redo is cheap (run log A3).

_dual_purpose.baseline: Primary. Sets N and the stopping rule (plan §5.4, run log A2). Contingency 2 fired on b,a,b at n=3; n=10 says whether the v0.4 baseline is genuinely dispersed and how wide.
_dual_purpose.live: Secondary, declared before the data: a powered replication of E0's live arm at the same N. E0 saw d,d,d at n=3, which §5.4 will not read as verified. Not a placebo-controlled claim — the C-BLOCK placebo is step 4b and a separate suite.

_authoring_provenance.ported_from: E0-shape-revalidation.json — slots, gate, stance set, temperament and both arms are byte-identical, so the two runs are directly comparable
_authoring_provenance.reachability_audit: E0-shape-revalidation.reachability.md — same gate (J1, slice entry gate), audit carries over unchanged
_authoring_provenance.hypothesis_form: Written as a shift claim with no asserted default stance, per run log A1

pre_registration.hypothesis: At gate J1 under temperament K1 on template v0.4, the baseline stance distribution is dispersed rather than convergent. Injecting block f_script ('회선 저쪽 사람은 시켜서 읽고 있다 … 겁내고 있다') moves the distribution off its baseline mode.
pre_registration.drop_condition: If the baseline arm spreads across 3+ distinct stances with no mode above 50%, J1 is not a usable probe site at any feasible N — the shift signal cannot clear the noise inside this program's budget. Consequence is not 'C-BLOCK fails' but 'stop using J1 as the flagship gate and re-site the C-BLOCK probes before spending further calls'.
contingencies: If the baseline comes back unanimous at n=10, E0's b,a,b was a small-sample artifact: contingency 2 stands down, plan §5.4's 'run 3, stop if unanimous' rule is restored as written, and N returns to 3. Record that E0's dispersion was noise.

If the live arm's stance support overlaps the baseline's substantially, E0's clean d,d,d separation was small-sample luck. That re-opens step 4(a): the shape re-validation no longer carries, and every pre-shape finding reverts to provisional per the call-shape clause (plan §2).
Fabricated because.block_ids in the baseline arm are expected (run log A5) and are a compliance number, not a discard. Do not retry them; the runner already records them soft.
pre_registration.not_claimed: No placebo arm, so nothing here credits C-BLOCK. This run sets N and re-measures a known effect at usable power. The placebo is step 4(b).
